turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Bună ziua! Mă ajut cu plăcere. Vă rog să-mi trimiteți numărul comenzii (de forma SC-1234) și adresa de email folosită la comandă. Apoi putem verifica dacă schimbarea adresei este posibilă și, dacă da, o pot trimite spre aprobare.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360. It has already shipped, and our policy allows address changes only until an order ships, so I can't change the delivery address now. You can follow the parcel with the courier using this link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360. If you need help with the parcel itself, I can help with that too.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: That new address is the one I need used.

I understand this is important to you, but I can't change the address on SC-3360. The order has already shipped, and our policy allows address changes only before shipping. The courier can still be contacted through the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360.
